what: independent round-5 review of the depth-3 six-architecture slice, by a reviewer who did not produce it

O1_decision_rule_sensitivity.reading: the verdict word is stable only if every bar and every seed subset gives it

O3_named_attention_installed_or_learned.source: predicate_induction_split in each seed's _interp3.json (zeroes pred_b / pred_c / pred_prof in place, restores them, and re-runs the identical induction battery)

with_named_terms_off_vs_plain_d3.reading: if the named-off score is at or below zero while the plain model at the same cell is clearly positive, the arm does not merely INSTALL the capability on top of a learned one - the rest of its network learned LESS induction than the plain model did

held_ce_with_named_terms_zeroed.note: this is an INFERENCE-TIME knockout of a trained model, not a retraining: it says how much of the trained model's behaviour the named terms carry, not what the same architecture would reach without them.

O5_headline_reproducibility.reading: a constant offset would mean a different but valid evaluation; unequal offsets mean the column cannot be reconstructed from any single artifact field

PD3_recomputed_on_resample.note: PD3 was registered on the zeroing number; it survives on the resample number too, but the magnitudes are 1.0-9.2x smaller

round4_plain_model_reference.source: tf_reviewer_round_4.json O2b, 243 pairs, plain model, depths 2-4, widths 64-256

O7_norm_share_regression_on_variants.reading: a slope near 2 with a small residual means the variants obey the same magnitude law as the plain model and PD3 is a size statement, not a routing one; a positive A0 offset from the PLAIN line would mean the variants transmit more than their write size predicts.
